title: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration…
description: A vulnerability in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration WordPress plugin before version 2.26.16.26 allows users with Subscriber role to inject SQL commands via profile data stored during backup of large database tables. This SQL is executed when an administrator restores the backup, potentially enabling privilege escalation such as granting administrator rights.
